body: Milvus is a high-performance, cloud-native vector database built for scalable vector ANN search
plain_description: **Store and search large collections of text, images, and other data for AI applications.** Build semantic, hybrid, and recommendation search experiences. Scale from a local quickstart to distributed deployments.
technical_description: Milvus is a high-performance vector database for organizing and searching unstructured data alongside scalar metadata. It supports vector indexes, metadata filtering, hybrid dense and sparse search, GPU indexing, horizontal scaling, and real-time streaming updates. It can run locally with Milvus Lite, in standalone mode, or as a distributed Kubernetes-native deployment. Integrations include LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, and Hugging Face.
title: Milvus
